about.lead: TAQAT is a Palestinian platform connecting coworking-space owners with freelancers and small teams across the Gaza Strip, providing an accessible, professional and easy-to-manage place to work.
about.missionBody: To give every freelancer in Gaza a place worthy of their ambition — fast internet, a supportive community, and transparent management tools, all from one platform.
about.visionBody: To be the core digital infrastructure of Palestine's freelance economy, connecting local talent with opportunities to grow.
about.value1d: Clear pricing and invoices with no hidden fees.
about.value2d: We build a collaborative network of workers and owners.
about.value3d: Verified spaces and high service standards.

faq.title: Everything you want to know
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about using TAQAT.

freelancer.q: How do I book a seat in a workspace?
freelancer.a: Browse spaces on the Explore page, pick the one that suits you, then tap “Request booking”. After logging in, your request reaches the owner for approval.

freelancer.q: Do I pay anything before the booking is confirmed?
freelancer.a: No. You won't be charged until the space owner confirms your request.

freelancer.q: How do I track my subscription and invoices?
freelancer.a: After logging in, you'll find all your subscriptions, invoices and seat in your dashboard.
Yes, you can send a booking request to any other space at any time.

owner.q: How do I add my space to TAQAT?
owner.a: Register as a space owner and complete your space details and required documents. Our team reviews requests within 24–48 hours.

owner.q: What is the commission on subscriptions?
owner.a: A transparent commission applies to each subscription, with full details shown in your dashboard.

owner.q: How do I manage seats and members?
owner.a: Your dashboard provides a live seat map and full management of members, invoices and packages.

owner.q: Can I edit prices and amenities?
owner.a: Yes, you can update your space details, pricing and amenities anytime from Settings.
